stage: After the initial cold Clarabel proposals and before reading Phase-A score flags
observed_implementation_issue: Clarabel frequently returned solver trouble on ill-conditioned cones for the signed local or modal programs.
uniform_retry: All 32 nodes rerun. Each proposal uses an interior state floor of 1e-7 times the receiver quadratic scale and per-cell adjusted weight limits 64 times that scale. A cold SCS solve may use the rest of each variant allowance after a Clarabel error or inaccurate result. Verify candidate coefficients against the original unregularized stored problem. Preserve initial failure traces.
trigger_for_acceptance: Only Arb one-sided positive K and strict old residual certificate. No optimizer error is scientific evidence of PSD incapacity.
timing_guard: The first stabilized run exposed late delivery of a Python deadline signal in the conic solver. A uniform 9.4 s online stop keeps all prefix work, latency, and independent replay within the 10 s per-node contract. This rerun covers all 32 nodes without consulting scored truth.
